title: Chromatic Aberration
description: Lens-like color separation concentrated toward the image edges.

uniforms.name: intensity
uniforms.label: Intensity
uniforms.description: Blend with the original image. Zero bypasses this layer.

uniforms.name: direction
uniforms.label: Direction
uniforms.description: Direction of channel separation in degrees.

uniforms.name: edgeBias
uniforms.label: Edge bias
uniforms.description: Concentrate separation at the edges instead of uniformly.
